newsitem.title: USA: Hershey buys back 9.9 mln shrs for $500 mln.
newsitem.headline: Hershey buys back 9.9 mln shrs for $500 mln.

text.p: Hershey Foods Corp said Friday it has bought 9,900,900 shares of its common stock from the Hershey Trust Co for $50.50 a share or about $500 million.
The company said that Hershey Trust, as trustee of the Milton Hershey School Trust, has advised it that the trust intends to retain voting control of the corporation, which it has held since 1918.
The trust sold the shares to diversify the school trust's investment holdings, the company said.
The trust will continue to review the school trust's holdings and undertake further diversivication as it deems appropriate.
The trust has no present intention of selling additinoal shares, it added.
With the transaction, Hershey Trust now holds 76.0 percent of the voting power of both classes of Hershey Food's common stock. Before the transaction, it held 76.5 percent.

The income of the school trust is used to pay the full cost of education and care for the students of the Milton Hershey School in Hershey, Pa., a private nonprofit boarding school for needy children.
Milton Hershey, founder of Hershey Foods, and his wife, Catherine, established the school trust in 1909.
